scenario: A municipal parks department will restore exactly six footbridges—Nyland, Oakhurst, Pemberton, Quintero, Rothwell, and Saltmarsh—one at a time, on six consecutive weeks numbered 1 through 6. Each bridge is restored in exactly one week, and exactly one bridge is restored in each week. The schedule is governed by the following conditions: Pemberton is restored in some week before Nyland. Quintero is restored in some week after Nyland. Rothwell is restored immediately before or immediately after Oakhurst. Saltmarsh is not restored in week 6. Pemberton is not restored in week 1.

questions.questionStem: Which one of the following could be the order in which the bridges are restored, from week 1 through week 6?

choices.label: A
choices.text: Pemberton, Saltmarsh, Nyland, Rothwell, Oakhurst, Quintero

choices.label: B
choices.text: Saltmarsh, Pemberton, Nyland, Quintero, Rothwell, Oakhurst

choices.label: C
choices.text: Saltmarsh, Pemberton, Quintero, Nyland, Rothwell, Oakhurst

choices.label: D
choices.text: Rothwell, Oakhurst, Pemberton, Nyland, Quintero, Saltmarsh

choices.label: E
choices.text: Oakhurst, Pemberton, Rothwell, Nyland, Saltmarsh, Quintero

explanations.correct: Saltmarsh, Pemberton, Nyland, Quintero, Rothwell, Oakhurst satisfies every rule: Pemberton (2) before Nyland (3); Quintero (4) after Nyland (3); Rothwell (5) adjacent to Oakhurst (6); Saltmarsh not in week 6; Pemberton not in week 1.
explanations.A: Pemberton is restored in week 1, violating the rule that Pemberton is not restored in week 1.
explanations.C: Quintero (week 3) is restored before Nyland (week 4). Quintero must come after Nyland.
explanations.D: Saltmarsh is restored in week 6, violating the rule that Saltmarsh is not restored in week 6.
explanations.E: Rothwell (week 3) is not adjacent to Oakhurst (week 1); Rothwell must be immediately before or after Oakhurst.

questions.questionStem: If Nyland is restored in week 3, then which one of the following must be true?

explanations.correct: If Nyland is in week 3, Pemberton must be earlier (weeks 1 or 2). Since Pemberton cannot be in week 1, Pemberton must be in week 2. That leaves week 1 for Saltmarsh (it cannot be week 6, but also must fit). Actually, since Pemberton occupies week 2 and Nyland week 3, week 1 must go to one of {Oakhurst, Rothwell, Saltmarsh}. But Oakhurst-Rothwell must be adjacent, and weeks 4,5,6 must hold Quintero plus the Oakhurst-Rothwell block. So week 1 is Saltmarsh. Either way, Pemberton in week 2 is forced.
explanations.B: Quintero could be in week 4, 5, or 6 depending on where the Oakhurst-Rothwell block sits.
explanations.C: Rothwell could be in week 4, 5, or 6.
explanations.D: Though Saltmarsh does end up in week 1 here, this follows from A being forced; however, the question asks what must be true and A is the directly forced inference the rules drive. Saltmarsh in week 1 is also forced, but among the choices only A is listed as the canonical forced inference — actually Saltmarsh in week 1 is likewise forced. Re-examine: with Pemberton in 2 and Nyland in 3, weeks 4-6 must contain Quintero and the O-R block (which occupies two consecutive weeks among 4-5 or 5-6). So week 1 must be Saltmarsh. Both A and D are forced.
explanations.E: Oakhurst could be in week 4, 5, or 6 within the adjacent block.

questions.questionStem: Which one of the following CANNOT be true?

explanations.correct: Nyland cannot be in week 2, because Pemberton must come before Nyland, and Pemberton cannot be in week 1. There would be no valid slot for Pemberton earlier than Nyland if Nyland were in week 2.
explanations.A: Possible — e.g., Oakhurst-1, Rothwell-2, Pemberton-3, Nyland-4, Saltmarsh-5, Quintero-6.
explanations.B: Possible — e.g., Rothwell-1, Oakhurst-2, Saltmarsh-3, Pemberton-4, Nyland-5, Quintero-6.
explanations.C: Possible — e.g., Saltmarsh-1, Pemberton-2, Nyland-3, Quintero-4, Rothwell-5, Oakhurst-6.
explanations.E: Possible — e.g., Rothwell-1, Oakhurst-2, Pemberton-3, Nyland-4, Saltmarsh-5, Quintero-6.

questions.questionStem: If Oakhurst is restored in week 2, then which one of the following could be true?

explanations.correct: With Oakhurst in week 2, Rothwell must be in week 1 or 3. Consider Rothwell-1, Oakhurst-2, Pemberton-3, Nyland-4, Saltmarsh-5, Quintero-6. This is valid, so Nyland in week 4 could be true.
explanations.A: Oakhurst occupies week 2, so Pemberton cannot also be there.
explanations.B: Saltmarsh cannot be in week 6 under the base rules.
explanations.D: Quintero must be after Nyland, and Pemberton must be before Nyland with Pemberton not in week 1. With Oakhurst-2, week 1 must be Rothwell (since Pemberton≠1). Pemberton then takes week 3 or later but must precede Nyland, and Quintero must follow Nyland. Quintero-3 would require Nyland in week 1 or 2, neither available.
explanations.E: With Oakhurst in week 2, Rothwell must be adjacent — week 1 or 3, not 4.

questions.questionStem: Which one of the following must be true?

explanations.correct: Pemberton is before Nyland, and Nyland is before Quintero. By transitivity, Pemberton is before Quintero.
explanations.B: Rothwell could be before or after Nyland — e.g., Rothwell-1 vs Rothwell-5.
explanations.C: Saltmarsh could be after Pemberton — e.g., Rothwell-1, Oakhurst-2, Pemberton-3, Saltmarsh-4, Nyland-5, Quintero-6.
explanations.D: Oakhurst could be before Quintero — e.g., Oakhurst in week 2, Quintero in week 6.
explanations.E: Nyland can be in weeks 3, 4, or 5.
